text:
Giant Anaconda Attacks Houseboat | Massive River Monster Horror - FULL SEQUENCE

I guess it's time to make some b movie micro-dramas?!?

Seedance 2 Prompt:
Cinematic Hollywood creature feature horror sequence on a stormy Amazon river with heavy rain and dark overcast skies. A massive giant anaconda, over 60 feet long with dark green and black patterned scales, swims aggressively through murky brown water, creating huge wakes as it pursues a large two-story houseboat.

On the deck, terrified passengers panic: a woman in white shirt runs screaming, an older man with white hair gestures wildly, a young person in tie-dye hoodie screams in fear, and a muscular man in black shirt points and shouts. The enormous anaconda suddenly lunges, coils powerfully around the boat, and violently capsizes it, sending people flying into the turbulent water.

Dynamic shots include high-angle aerial views of the chase, chaotic deck panic with heavy rain, dramatic low-angle shots of the anaconda rising and striking, and intense capsizing action with massive splashes and waves. Photorealistic creature details, realistic water physics, cinematic storm lighting, shaky intense camera work, high-tension survival horror atmosphere. 14-second thrilling monster attack sequence.

Seedance 2 Extention 1 Prompt:
Cinematic horror extension sequence (15 seconds total) continuing from the capsized houseboat in a stormy jungle river with heavy rain:

Shot 1 (0-2s): High-angle and underwater view as the houseboat fully capsizes. Multiple passengers fall screaming into the turbulent murky water. Show their legs and feet kicking desperately from below the surface as they struggle in the chaotic waves and splashes.

Shot 2 (2-4s): The massive giant anaconda powerfully swims through the brown river water, its long patterned body coiling and gliding underwater with smooth, menacing movements, creating bubbles and currents.

Shot 3 (4-7s): The giant anaconda strikes suddenly from behind, grabbing one struggling passenger underwater and dragging him down violently with massive splashes and thrashing.

Shot 4 (7-10s): The young man in the colorful tie-dye hoodie swims frantically toward the muddy shore. In the background, the old man with white hair and the woman in the white shirt shout desperately, "Swim! Swim!" 

Shot 5 (10-15s): The old man and woman in white shirt reach the shore, look back in horror as they witness the attack. Shocked and terrified, they start running into the dense jungle. The giant anaconda swims aggressively toward the shore, its head rising from the water as the scene ends.

Seedance 2 Extention 2 Prompt:
Cinematic horror extension sequence continuing from the river bank in heavy rain:

Shot 1 (0-3s): The woman in white shirt, young man in tie-dye hoodie, and old man with white hair frantically swim to the muddy shore, splashing through shallow water. They climb onto land, look back in terror as the massive giant anaconda swims aggressively toward the shore, its head rising from the water.

Shot 2 (3-6s): Panicked, the three survivors run into the dense jungle. The giant anaconda reaches the shore, slithers out powerfully, and begins chasing them through the trees with fast, crushing movements.

Shot 3 (6-9s): During the chase, the old man trips and falls. The anaconda closes in rapidly. He shouts desperately, “Go! Run!” while pointing toward a small rock formation.

Shot 4 (9-12s): The woman in white shirt and young man in tie-dye crawl quickly through a narrow rock opening/cave. The old man stays behind to stall. The giant anaconda lunges and catches him.

Shot 5 (12-15s): Inside the tight cave, the two survivors look back in horror. The anaconda forces its massive head against the small opening, jaws wide, flicking its long slithery tongue inside, trying to reach them but unable to enter due to the tiny gap.

Shot 6 (15-18s): The woman in white and the young man in colorful hoodie breathe in relief inside the safe crevice, realizing they survived thanks to the old man’s sacrifice. Dramatic rain, realistic jungle atmosphere, high-tension survival horror style, photorealistic details.

Final video post polishing and clipping - 35/36 seconds.

Whole sequence made using Seedance 2 on @haimeta_ai

A massive giant anaconda, over 60 feet long with dark green and black patterned scales, swims aggressively through murky brown water, creating huge wakes as it pursues a large two-story houseboat.

On the deck, terrified passengers panic: a woman in white shirt runs screaming, an older man with white hair gestures wildly, a young person in tie-dye hoodie screams in fear, and a muscular man in black shirt points and shouts. The enormous anaconda suddenly lunges, coils powerfully around the boat, and violently capsizes it, sending people flying into the turbulent water.

translations.es:
Secuencia de terror de criaturas cinematográficas de Hollywood en un tormentoso río Amazonas con lluvia intensa y cielos nublados oscuros. Una anaconda gigante, de más de 60 pies de largo con escamas de patrones verde oscuro y negro, nada agresivamente a través del agua marrón turbia, creando grandes estelas mientras persigue una gran casa flotante de dos pisos.

En la cubierta, los pasajeros aterrorizados entran en pánico: una mujer con camisa blanca corre gritando, un hombre mayor con cabello blanco gesticula frenéticamente, una persona joven con sudadera de tie-dye grita de miedo, y un hombre musculoso con camisa negra señala y grita. La enorme anaconda de repente se lanza, se enrolla poderosamente alrededor del bote y lo vuelca violentamente, enviando a las personas volando al agua turbulenta.

Las tomas dinámicas incluyen vistas aéreas en ángulo alto de la persecución, pánico caótico en la cubierta con lluvia intensa, tomas dramáticas en ángulo bajo de la anaconda elevándose y atacando, y acción intensa de vuelco con enormes salpicaduras y olas. Detalles de criaturas fotorrealistas, física realista del agua, iluminación de tormenta cinematográfica, trabajo de cámara tembloroso e intenso, atmósfera de horror de supervivencia de alta tensión. Secuencia emocionante de ataque de monstruo de 14 segundos.
translations.fr:
---
Séquence d'horreur cinématographique de créature hollywoodienne sur un fleuve Amazonien orageux avec une pluie battante et un ciel sombre et couvert. Un anaconda géant massif, de plus de 60 pieds de long avec des écailles aux motifs vert foncé et noir, nage agressivement à travers une eau brunâtre et trouble, créant d'énormes sillages alors qu'il poursuit un grand bateau-maison à deux étages.

Sur le pont, des passagers terrifiés paniquent : une femme en chemise blanche court en criant, un homme plus âgé aux cheveux blancs gesticule frénétiquement, une jeune personne en sweat à capuche tie-dye hurle de peur, et un homme musclé en chemise noire pointe et crie. L'énorme anaconda se jette soudainement, s'enroule puissamment autour du bateau et le fait chavirer violemment, projetant les gens dans l'eau tumultueuse.

Les plans dynamiques incluent des vues aériennes en plongée de la poursuite, la panique chaotique sur le pont sous la pluie battante, des plans dramatiques en contre-plongée de l'anaconda qui se dresse et attaque, et une action intense de chavirement avec d'énormes éclaboussures et vagues. Détails photoréalistes de la créature, physique de l'eau réaliste, éclairage de tempête cinématographique, travail de caméra intense et tremblant, atmosphère d'horreur de survie à haute tension. Séquence palpitante d'attaque de monstre de 14 secondes.
translations.ja:
---
シネマティックなハリウッドのクリーチャーフィーチャーホラーシークエンス。嵐のアマゾン川で、激しい雨と暗い曇り空の下。全長60フィートを超える巨大なアナコンダが、暗緑色と黒の模様の鱗を持ち、濁った茶色の水を激しく泳ぎ、大きな波を立てながら二階建てのハウスボートを追いかける。

デッキでは、恐怖に駆られた乗客たちがパニックに陥る。白いシャツを着た女性が叫びながら走り、白髪の年配の男性が激しくジェスチャーをし、タイダイのフーディーを着た若者が恐怖で叫び、黒いシャツを着た筋肉質の男性が指を指して叫ぶ。巨大なアナコンダが突然飛びかかり、ボートに力強く巻き付き、激しく転覆させ、人々を荒れ狂う水中に放り出す。

ダイナミックなショットには、追跡の高角度の空撮、激しい雨の中の混乱したデッキのパニック、アナコンダが立ち上がり襲いかかる劇的な低角度ショット、そして巨大な水しぶきと波を伴う激しい転覆アクションが含まれる。フォトリアリスティックなクリーチャーのディテール、リアルな水の物理、シネマティックな嵐の照明、揺れる激しいカメラワーク、高い緊張感のあるサバイバルホラーの雰囲気。14秒間のスリリングなモンスターアタックシークエンス。
translations.ko:
---
폭풍우가 몰아치는 아마존 강에서의 시네마틱 할리우드 크리처 피처 호러 시퀀스. 짙은 회색 구름이 드리운 하늘 아래, 길이 60피트가 넘는 거대한 아나콘다가 어두운 녹색과 검은색 패턴의 비늘을 가진 채 탁한 갈색 물을 공격적으로 헤엄치며, 큰 2층 하우스보트를 쫓아가며 거대한 물결을 일으킨다.

갑판 위에서는 공포에 질린 승객들이 패닉에 빠진다: 흰 셔츠를 입은 여자가 비명을 지르며 달리고, 백발의 노인이 격렬하게 손짓을 하며, 타이다이 후디를 입은 젊은이가 두려움에 비명을 지르고, 검은 셔츠를 입은 근육질의 남자가 가리키며 소리친다. 거대한 아나콘다가 갑자기 덤벼들어 보트를 강력하게 감싸고, 격렬하게 전복시켜 사람들을 격랑의 물속으로 날려 보낸다.

다이나믹한 샷에는 추격을 담은 고각 항공 뷰, 폭우 속의 혼란스러운 갑판의 패닉, 아나콘다가 솟아오르고 공격하는 극적인 저각 샷, 거대한 물보라와 파도가 일어나는 강렬한 전복 액션이 포함된다. 포토리얼리스틱한 크리처 디테일, 현실적인 물리학, 시네마틱한 폭풍 조명, 흔들리는 강렬한 카메라 워크, 고조된 서바이벌 호러 분위기. 14초의 스릴 넘치는 몬스터 공격 시퀀스.
translations.pt-BR:
Sequência de terror cinematográfica de criatura de Hollywood em um rio Amazônico tempestuoso, com chuva forte e céu nublado escuro. Uma anaconda gigante, com mais de 18 metros de comprimento e escamas com padrões verde escuro e preto, nada agressivamente através da água marrom turva, criando grandes ondas enquanto persegue uma grande casa flutuante de dois andares.

No convés, passageiros aterrorizados entram em pânico: uma mulher de camisa branca corre gritando, um homem mais velho de cabelo branco gesticula freneticamente, uma pessoa jovem com moletom tie-dye grita de medo, e um homem musculoso de camisa preta aponta e grita. A enorme anaconda de repente avança, se enrola poderosamente ao redor do barco e o vira violentamente, lançando as pessoas na água turbulenta.

Os planos dinâmicos incluem vistas aéreas de ângulo alto da perseguição, pânico caótico no convés com chuva forte, tomadas dramáticas de ângulo baixo da anaconda se erguendo e atacando, e ação intensa de capotagem com grandes respingos e ondas. Detalhes fotorrealistas da criatura, física realista da água, iluminação cinematográfica de tempestade, trabalho de câmera tremido e intenso, atmosfera de horror de sobrevivência de alta tensão. Sequência emocionante de ataque de monstro de 14 segundos.
translations.zh-CN:
---
在亚马逊河暴风雨中拍摄的好莱坞电影级生物恐怖片段，倾盆大雨和阴沉的天空。一个超过60英尺长的巨型蟒蛇，身披深绿色和黑色斑纹的鳞片，凶猛地游过浑浊的棕色水域，掀起巨大的水波，追逐一艘两层楼高的游艇。

甲板上，惊恐的乘客们陷入恐慌：一名穿白衬衫的女子尖叫着奔跑，一位白发老人疯狂地挥手，一个穿扎染连帽衫的年轻人惊恐地尖叫，还有一个穿黑衬衫的肌肉男指着大喊。巨大的蟒蛇突然猛扑，强力缠绕住船只，猛烈地将其掀翻，把人们抛入汹涌的水中。

动态镜头包括追逐的高角度航拍视角、甲板上混乱的恐慌场景伴随大雨、蟒蛇升起和攻击的戏剧性低角度镜头，以及翻船时巨大的水花和波浪。逼真的生物细节、真实的水体物理效果、电影级风暴照明、晃动的紧张摄像效果，高张力的生存恐怖氛围。14秒惊险的怪物攻击片段。
